method.seedAlgorithm: Mix32(0x54595241 + attemptIndex), frozen indices 0..99; LCG1664525/1013904223 mod2^32
method.success: A fresh sector1 run reaches the hangar after sector10, without retry; normal reserve-ship respawns and legal shop purchases are allowed.
limitations: Deterministic artificial pilot; the measured sample is not a promise of human success rates.
Headless simulation omits ground scenery, its collisions, destruction rewards and ground bonus drops.
Pilot reads current entity positions and velocities; it cannot alter health, inventory, damage, currency, RNG outcomes or the wave director.
method.controls: Nine movement choices at 10 Hz, .48s projectile prediction, visible beam/contact avoidance, nearby pickup pursuit, pulse/plasma and defensive Nova use.
method.shop: Buy reserve ships to 2, planned weapon tiers 2/4/5/6, one wing drone, balanced recharge/shield/hull, then Nova stock to 3.
method.calibration: REAL_PRESSURE is tuned against this frozen sample for 10/100 Real completions. These are calibration outcomes, not an independent validation sample.
